senses.gloss: When the seeds are sown, only the upper cover is the beginining; gradually the inner milk like substance gets solidified and the grain is formed. That darkness (Tamas is manifested in Śiva; slowly comes activity (Rajas) and serenity (sattva)' the three Guṇas also personify Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva. 653.
